# UBC Blogs

> A WordPress-based blogging platform for teaching, learning, and institutional communication at the University of British Columbia.

UBC Blogs is a hosted platform maintained by the Centre for Teaching, Learning and Technology (CTLT) that enables faculty, students, and staff to create and manage blogs for course websites, research dissemination, and community engagement. The platform emphasizes accessibility, privacy, and collaborative learning within the UBC community.
